Description:
[​🇵​​🇱​​🇪​​🇦​​🇸​​🇪​ ​🇳​​🇴​​🇹​​🇪​, ​🇹​​🇭​​🇪​​🇷​​🇪​ ​🇭​​🇦​​🇸​ ​🇧​​🇪​​🇪​​🇳​ ​🇸​​🇴​​🇲​​🇪​ ​🇸​​🇱​​🇮​​🇬​​🇭​​🇹​ ​🇲​​🇴​​🇩​​🇮​​🇫​​🇨​​🇦​​🇹​​🇮​​🇴​​🇳​​🇸​ ​🇧​​🇪​​🇸​​🇮​​🇩​​🇪​​🇸​ ​🇹​​🇭​​🇪​ ​🇺​​🇵​​🇸​​🇨​​🇦​​🇱​​🇪​. ​🇵​​🇱​​🇪​​🇦​​🇸​​🇪​ ​🇰​​🇪​​🇪​​🇵​ ​🇹​​🇭​​🇦​​🇹​ ​🇮​​🇳​ ​🇲​​🇮​​🇳​​🇩​ ​🇼​​🇭​​🇪​​🇳​ ​🇩​​🇴​​🇼​​🇳​​🇱​​🇴​​🇦​​🇩​​🇮​​🇳​​🇬​ ​🇹​​🇭​​🇮​​🇸​ ​🇲​​🇴​​🇩​!]

The kids of Stardew Kids Expansion are adorable! There's no offical or unoffical portrait mod for them, so I decided to be the first! This mod includes all 5 kids getting an upscaled version of their portraits. This doesn't include any fancy seasonal variants or costumes as the original mod doesn't include that.

Please Note: This mod is just to adapt the kids into Talkohlooeys' art style, so there's not any creative liberties in their poses. Simply put, I used Jas and Vincent's portraits from the main mod as bases models to keep in style!

[u][b]04/11 Update: [/b]Uploaded a File that should remove the dependance of HD Portraits. Please post if bugs occur![/u]
